title: carex spicata f. pseudoguestphalica
intro: Carex spicata f. pseudoguestphalica, commonly known as  Carex pseudogriesebachii, is a type of sedge, a monocotyledonous perennial plant. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including treating digestive issues, fever, and rheumatism. The therapeutic actions of Carex spicata f. pseudoguestphalica include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and diuretic properties. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
